title: KAMANU fact
description: What one query found on one line of one code property graph. Extra fields are allowed: a query may add to a fact, never take from it.

file.description: Source file relative to the repository root, with forward slashes on every OS.

line.description: 1-based line in that file, Joern's own LINE_NUMBER.

query_id.description: The query that found it: 'calls', or a query script's file name without its extension.

subject.description: What was found. For the query 'calls', the callee's last identifier.

joern_version.description: The version of the Joern that ran, read from the installation.

graph_hash.description: SHA-256 of the graph's content, without its absolute root and independent of node ids.

construct.description: Optional. The construct of the query's manifest the witness is of. A fact without one is a pattern's match and no more.

assumptions.description: Optional. The assumptions under which a match of the construct implies the premise, each written out.

record.description: Optional. The record of the run or live probe that showed it: a path, relative, with forward slashes.
